guide.tmoveis.awning.text: Wall decoration, over windows and doors. Makes 2.
guide.tmoveis.awning.title: Awning
guide.tmoveis.bathtub.text: 2 blocks. Fill it with buckets or a pipe (up to 3 buckets). Getting in the water puts out fire.
guide.tmoveis.bathtub.title: Bathtub
guide.tmoveis.beam.text: A sawn wooden pillar. Lies along the side you click, like logs. Made in the Sawmill from 1 plank.
guide.tmoveis.beam.title: Beam
guide.tmoveis.brushing.text:
Right-click planks, stairs, slabs, new blocks or furniture with the brush: they take the varnish color.

Oak stays oak, facing the same way. Not doors, fences or trapdoors.
guide.tmoveis.brushing.title: Varnishing
guide.tmoveis.bunk_bed.text: A ladder and 2 beds of one color. Two real beds: each one sleeps one player.
guide.tmoveis.bunk_bed.title: Bunk Bed
guide.tmoveis.cabinet.text: 27 slots, like a chest. The doors open while the inventory is open.
guide.tmoveis.cabinet.title: Cabinet
guide.tmoveis.ceiling_fan.text: On the ceiling. Spins with redstone (stronger signal, faster) or Industrial energy.
guide.tmoveis.ceiling_fan.title: Ceiling Fan
guide.tmoveis.chair.text: Faces the way you look when you place it: seated, you look the same way. Makes 2.
guide.tmoveis.chair.title: Chair
guide.tmoveis.chandelier.text: Hangs from the ceiling: needs a block above it. The brightest light.
guide.tmoveis.chandelier.title: Chandelier
guide.tmoveis.coffee_table.text: Click with an item to put it on top; an empty hand takes it back.
guide.tmoveis.coffee_table.title: Coffee Table
guide.tmoveis.counter.text: Stone top and a 9-slot cupboard. In an L, the corner sorts itself out. Makes 2.
guide.tmoveis.counter.title: Counter
guide.tmoveis.cover.text:
Chairs, tables, cabinets, sofas, beds, lamps and the whole house: kitchen, bedroom, bathroom and garden.

Wooden furniture comes in every wood of the game: swap the planks and the slab in the recipe.
guide.tmoveis.cover.title: Furniture Guide
guide.tmoveis.curtain.text: Click to open or close. Neighbouring curtains facing the same way move together. Makes 2.
guide.tmoveis.curtain.title: Curtain
guide.tmoveis.desk.text: 3 drawers, 9 slots. Side by side, desks join into one long top.
guide.tmoveis.desk.title: Desk
guide.tmoveis.double_bed.text: 2 beds of the same color. Takes 2 by 2 blocks: needs room to the right and ahead.
guide.tmoveis.double_bed.title: Double Bed
guide.tmoveis.double_bed_use.text:
Works like a normal bed: skips the night and sets your respawn point. Two people fit, one on each side.

In the Nether and the End it explodes!
guide.tmoveis.double_bed_use.title: Sleeping
guide.tmoveis.drawer.text: 27 slots, like a chest. The top drawer opens while the inventory is open.
guide.tmoveis.drawer.title: Chest of Drawers
guide.tmoveis.fan_climate.text:
With the Clima mod, a spinning fan cools the room in summer (5 blocks around).

The fan light turns on with it.
guide.tmoveis.fan_climate.title: Fan and climate
guide.tmoveis.finish.text:
Changes the color of wood and protects it from rain.

7 tones: Natural, Honey, Walnut, Mahogany, Ebony, White and Black Lacquer.

For planks, stairs, slabs, new blocks, furniture.
guide.tmoveis.finish.title: Varnish
guide.tmoveis.fireplace.text: Add firewood (sticks or logs) and light it with Flint and Steel or the Clima Lighter. A shovel puts it out.
guide.tmoveis.fireplace.title: Fireplace
guide.tmoveis.fireplace_use.text:
A log lasts 1 minute; a stick, 20 seconds. Without firewood it goes out.

With the Clima mod it warms the room (6 blocks around).

⚠ Burns whoever touches the fire.
guide.tmoveis.fireplace_use.title: Firewood and heat
guide.tmoveis.floor_lamp.text: 2 blocks tall. Lights up with redstone or Industrial energy.
guide.tmoveis.floor_lamp.title: Floor Lamp
guide.tmoveis.floorboards.text: Long boards with staggered joints, for floors. Made in the Sawmill from 1 plank. Has stairs and slabs.
guide.tmoveis.floorboards.title: Floorboards
guide.tmoveis.garden_bench.text: To sit outdoors: click, and sneak to stand up.
guide.tmoveis.garden_bench.title: Garden Bench
guide.tmoveis.guide_book.text: A book and any planks on the crafting table make a new guide.
guide.tmoveis.guide_book.title: Guide Book
guide.tmoveis.herringbone.text: Short boards in a zigzag, like in old halls. Made in the Sawmill from 1 plank. Has stairs and slabs.
guide.tmoveis.herringbone.title: Herringbone
guide.tmoveis.house.text:
Kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, living room and garden.

Doors, drawers, lids, curtains and shutters open smoothly, like the chest lid, and close by themselves when you leave the inventory.
guide.tmoveis.house.title: The whole house
guide.tmoveis.lamp_energy.text:
With Industrial: connect a Copper Wire or a cable to the lamp, or place it against a battery or panel.

Each lamp uses 1 J/t: a single Copper Wire powers up to 32 lamps.
guide.tmoveis.lamp_energy.title: With energy
guide.tmoveis.lamps.text:
Chandelier, wall sconce, table lamp and floor lamp light up with redstone, like the Redstone Lamp.

With the Industrial mod they also run on energy.
guide.tmoveis.lamps.title: Lamps
guide.tmoveis.mail_use.text:
To send items to another player, put them in their mailbox.

If they are online they get a message right away; otherwise when they join.
guide.tmoveis.mail_use.title: Sending mail
guide.tmoveis.mailbox.text: Anyone can drop items; only the owner takes them or breaks it. Blasts and hoppers can't empty it. The flag rises with mail.
guide.tmoveis.mailbox.title: Mailbox
guide.tmoveis.mirror.text: Wall decoration: click the side of a block.
guide.tmoveis.mirror.title: Mirror
guide.tmoveis.nightstand.text: 9 slots. The top drawer slides out while the inventory is open.
guide.tmoveis.nightstand.title: Nightstand
guide.tmoveis.paneling.text: Standing grooved boards, to line walls. Made in the Sawmill from 1 plank. No stairs or slabs.
guide.tmoveis.paneling.title: Paneling
guide.tmoveis.parquet.text: Squares of lying and standing boards, alternating. Made in the Sawmill from 1 plank. Has stairs and slabs.
guide.tmoveis.parquet.title: Parquet
guide.tmoveis.piano.text: 2 blocks wide. Each key plays a note: low ones on the left, high ones on the right.
guide.tmoveis.piano.title: Piano
guide.tmoveis.planter_box.text: Flowers, saplings and seeds grow in it like in wet farmland.
guide.tmoveis.planter_box.title: Planter Box
guide.tmoveis.polish.text:
Use the same brush again: the wood gets polished, with more shine.

A brush of another tone changes the color (not polished).
guide.tmoveis.polish.title: Polishing
guide.tmoveis.protect.text:
Varnished wood never weathers.

Already weathered? The axe scrapes one stage off. A brush on weathered wood restores the color and protects it.
guide.tmoveis.protect.title: Protecting
guide.tmoveis.remove_varnish.text:
Right-click with an axe, like copper wax:

polished → varnished → raw wood.

Each scrape uses the axe.
guide.tmoveis.remove_varnish.title: Removing varnish
guide.tmoveis.safe.text: 27 slots. Only the owner opens and breaks it. Blasts, hoppers and other players can't.
guide.tmoveis.safe.title: Safe
guide.tmoveis.sawmill.text: Cuts wood like the stonecutter. The saw spins while the screen is open.
guide.tmoveis.sawmill.title: Sawmill
guide.tmoveis.sawmill_use.text:
Log → 6 planks (crafting gives 4).

Plank → parquet, herringbone, floorboards, paneling, beam, stairs, 2 slabs or 2 sticks.

Parquet, herringbone, floorboards → stairs or 2 slabs.
guide.tmoveis.sawmill_use.title: In the Sawmill
guide.tmoveis.shutters.text: Click to swing them open or shut. Makes 2.
guide.tmoveis.shutters.title: Shutters
guide.tmoveis.side_table.text: For next to the sofa. It also shows the item you put on top.
guide.tmoveis.side_table.title: Side Table
guide.tmoveis.sink.text: Fill it with a water bucket or a fluid pipe (1 bucket). Take water with a bucket or bottle. No lava.
guide.tmoveis.sink.title: Kitchen Sink
guide.tmoveis.sitting.text:
Right-click a chair, stool or sofa to sit down. Sneak to stand up.

One person per block. Breaking the furniture stands the sitter up.
guide.tmoveis.sitting.title: Sitting
guide.tmoveis.sofa.text: Wool of any color and slabs of any wood. Makes 2. The front faces you.
guide.tmoveis.sofa.title: Sofa
guide.tmoveis.sofa_shapes.text:
Sofas side by side become one long sofa: armrests only at the ends.

In an L they make a corner, like stairs. Different colors join too.
guide.tmoveis.sofa_shapes.title: Joined sofas
guide.tmoveis.stool.text: No backrest: sit facing any way. Makes 2.
guide.tmoveis.stool.title: Stool
guide.tmoveis.storage_use.text:
Cabinets and chests of drawers work with hoppers (in from the top and sides, out from the bottom) and comparators.

Breaking one drops its contents.
guide.tmoveis.storage_use.title: Storage
guide.tmoveis.table.text: Tables side by side join into one top. Legs stay only on the outer corners.
guide.tmoveis.table.title: Table
guide.tmoveis.table_lamp.text: On top of a table, cabinet or any block.
guide.tmoveis.table_lamp.title: Table Lamp
guide.tmoveis.toilet.text: Click to sit down. Sneak to stand up.
guide.tmoveis.toilet.title: Toilet
guide.tmoveis.trash_can.text: ⚠ Items are gone forever: when you close it, or right away if a hopper puts them in.
guide.tmoveis.trash_can.title: Trash Can
guide.tmoveis.varnish.text: Glass bottle, honeycomb and what gives the tone its color (here: a honey bottle).
guide.tmoveis.varnish.title: Making varnish
guide.tmoveis.varnish_brush.text: Wool, varnish and a stick. One brush per tone; 64 coats. Gives the bottle back.
guide.tmoveis.varnish_brush.title: Varnish Brush
guide.tmoveis.varnish_tones.text:
Bottle, honeycomb and:
Natural: more honeycomb
Honey: honey bottle
Walnut: brown
Mahogany: brown and red
Ebony: charcoal
White Lacquer: white
Black Lacquer: black

The colors are dyes.
guide.tmoveis.varnish_tones.title: The 7 tones
guide.tmoveis.wall_clock.text: On a wall. The hands show the time of the world, like the pocket clock.
guide.tmoveis.wall_clock.title: Wall Clock
guide.tmoveis.wall_lamp.text: Fixed to a wall: click the side of a block. Makes 2.
guide.tmoveis.wall_lamp.title: Wall Sconce
guide.tmoveis.wardrobe.text: 2 cabinets of the same wood. 2 blocks tall, 36 slots.
guide.tmoveis.wardrobe.title: Wardrobe
guide.tmoveis.weathering.text:
Raw wood from this mod (new blocks and furniture) weathers in the rain under open sky: 3 stages, about 9 game days each.

Vanilla wood and existing houses never change.
guide.tmoveis.weathering.title: Weathering
guide.tmoveis.wine_rack.text: 9 cells, bottles and potions only. Click a cell with a bottle; an empty hand takes it.
guide.tmoveis.wine_rack.title: Wine Rack
message.tmoveis.mail_waiting: You have mail waiting: %s mailbox(es), the first at %s.
tooltip.tmoveis.mailbox: Anyone can put in; only the owner takes out or breaks it.
tooltip.tmoveis.safe: Only the owner opens and breaks it. Blast-proof.
tooltip.tmoveis.trash_can: ⚠ Items are gone forever when you close it.
